hints.content:
We are trying to find a **unit rate**, specifically the number of runs allowed per $1$ inning.

$\dfrac{\blueE{\text{runs}}}{\maroonD{\text{innings}}} = \purpleD{\text{runs per inning}}$

We can compare from the largest to the smallest place value.

###Finding the unit rates

We divide based on the unit rate we want.

Pitcher| $\blueE{\text{Runs allowed}} $ || $\maroonD{\text{Innings pitched}}$||$\purpleD{\text{Runs per inning}}$ 
- | :-: | :-:| :-:|:-:|:-:
Randy|$2$|$\div$ | $3$|$\approx$|$0.67$
Felix|$4$ |$\div$ |$5$ | $=$|$0.8$
Johan |$5$ |$\div$ | $7$|$\approx$| $0.71 $

###Comparing the unit rates

Pitcher | Ones | $.$ | Tenths | Hundredths
- | :-: | :-:| :-:|:-:|:-:
Randy| $0$ | $.$ | $\redE{6}$ | $7$
Felix| $0$ | $.$ | $8$ | $0$
Johan | $0$ | $.$ | $7$ | $1$

The pitchers all have $0$ ones of runs per inning, but Randy has the least tenths of runs per inning.

###Conclusion

Randy has the lowest number of runs allowed per inning.

question.content:
A baseball team has three different pitchers. Randy allowed $2$ runs and pitched $3$ innings. Felix allowed $4$ runs and pitched $5$ innings. Johan allowed $5$ runs and pitched $7$ innings. 

**Which pitcher has the lowest *number of runs allowed per inning*?**

[[☃ radio 1]]
